name: 24syv
whatWeDo:
We are a group of passionate tech and media professionals who strive to create an innovative news product that is valuable to people who absolutely love news as well as people who just want to know what’s most important. We believe it should be easy and convenient to be informed about current affairs and to get different perspectives from different media. Therefore, we want to provide a nice and attractive gateway to all the great journalism out there. We really believe that audio news is the future, because it respects people’s time and enables us to do the things we love while also getting up to date. Our office is situated in Copenhagen.

What is the product?

24syv is an innovative news platform run by the Danish tech startup Listen to News ApS. The app collects audio content from a range of news media and structures it so the news listener can get a quick and thorough news briefing - on demand - in just 10 minutes. After the news briefing, the news listener is presented with podcast clip from programs with in-depth knowledge about current topics that matter to the news listener. In this way, the news listener can become completely up to date and ready to talk about current affairs with friends, family and colleagues just by listening to listen to news on their way to work.

29× er et digitalt kreativt studio. Vi er en samling specialister, som arbejder sammen under et fælles banner – med masser af erfaring fra stort og småt og en dedikeret og nysgerrig tilgang til de projekter, vi kaster os ud i.

Vi bevæger os i krydsfeltet mellem det digitalt kreative, det konceptuelle og det, der giver mærkbare resultater på bundlinjerne. Ambitionsniveauet er højt, fagligheden ditto, tonen jordnær og fødderne grounded.

Ønsket om større frihed, tættere kunderelationer og mere selvstændighed vægter højt hos alle ved 29×.

Bag navnet ligger et værdisæt og en fælles overbevisning om, at et stærkt sammenhold, hvor alle kender alle og hvor ånden og arbejdsglæden stortrives, giver de bedste resultater for dem, vi er her for; vores kunder.

Vi har besluttet, at vi ikke vil være mere end 29 ansatte.

For os er det væsentligt, at vi kan levere solid og helhjertet rådgivning og kvalitetsløsninger, men også at man som kunde i 29× har faste relationer til dem, der udfører opgaven. Det tror vi på, giver den bedste kundeoplevelse.

name: e1
whatWeDo:
Navigating the electric vehicle landscape can be challenging, especially when it comes to finding a reliable charging station. e1 - EV Charging is here to simplify your EV journey.

Our mobile app offers real-time information on all registered charging stations across Iceland, allowing you to pick the perfect spot based on your preferences for cost and location. The app not only tracks your charging progress but also facilitates seamless payments, making the entire experience hassle-free.

Choosing our platform saves you both time and money, but the benefits don't stop at the consumer level. Charging station owners can join the e1 network and generate revenue every time an EV user charges at their station.

In a world that's increasingly going digital, e1 aims to enhance the EV driving experience. We're committed to promoting electric vehicle adoption by providing a unified marketplace for convenient and accessible charging solutions.

Download the e1 - eONE EV Charging mobile app now, exclusively available on the App Store and Google Play.

name: Gangverk
whatWeDo:
Gangverk is a software consultancy founded by seasoned software professionals. We have been creating applications for over a decade. We pride ourselves in our ability to offer our clients assistance throughout the creative process from conception to design to implementation, operation and maintenance.

Gangverk is an icelandic word that literally means "that what makes stuff tick"​, originally coined for the machinery of clocks but in later times has taken over the connotation of whatever it is that keeps things operating smoothly underneath a polished exterior. We like to make stuff tick so we thought the name was a good match even though it's not the easiest word to pronounce for non-icelandic speaking peoples (a surprisingly large proportion of the world).

We are based in Reykjavik, Iceland. We have team members from all over the world and work for international clients.
